textos.title: Digital Monitoring and Operational Reliability
textos.content:
For decades, industrial operators relied on scheduled inspections to identify early signs of equipment failure. Today, sensors placed on pumps, pipelines and offshore platforms produce a continuous stream of data. By comparing current measurements with historical patterns, software can alert teams to unusual vibration or temperature before breakdowns occur.

Yet more data does not automatically lead to safer operations. A warning may be ignored if it arrives too often, and an algorithm trained on conditions at one facility may perform poorly at another. Engineers therefore need to check the quality of measurements, investigate unexpected alerts and decide when maintenance is truly necessary.

Some companies have introduced remote monitoring centers to support field teams. These centers do not replace technicians; rather, they give them additional information that may help them prioritize inspections. When communication links fail, however, local procedures and experienced personnel remain essential.

Ultimately, predictive maintenance works best when digital tools are combined with human judgment, clear responsibilities and regular equipment inspections.

textos.title: Energy Transition and Infrastructure
textos.content:
The transition toward cleaner energy sources has encouraged companies to invest in renewable technologies. However, replacing existing infrastructure is neither simple nor inexpensive.

Although renewable energy can reduce greenhouse gas emissions, its integration into national power systems requires substantial investments in transmission networks, storage facilities and skilled personnel.

Experts argue that a successful energy transition depends not only on technological innovation but also on long-term planning and cooperation between governments and private companies.

questoes.enunciado: According to the text, the main advantage of digital monitoring systems is that they

alternativas.A: completely eliminate the need for regular equipment inspections.
alternativas.B: improve maintenance decisions when combined with human expertise.
alternativas.C: guarantee that industrial equipment will never experience failures.
alternativas.D: allow the same predictive models to work equally well at every facility.
alternativas.E: transfer all operational responsibilities from technicians to remote centers.

questoes.comentario: Monitoramento apoia as decisões, sem substituir a experiência humana.

questoes.enunciado: In the second paragraph, the author suggests that an excessive number of alerts may

alternativas.A: increase the accuracy of every predictive model.
alternativas.B: eliminate the possibility of equipment failure.
alternativas.C: make operators less responsive to important warnings.
alternativas.D: reduce the amount of data collected by sensors.

questoes.comentario: Avisos excessivamente frequentes podem ser ignorados.

In "These centers do not replace technicians; rather, they give them additional information that may help them prioritize inspections", the pronouns they and them refer, respectively, to
questoes.comentario: They retoma centers; them retoma technicians.

According to the text, a successful energy transition requires

alternativas.A: the immediate replacement of all existing energy infrastructure.
alternativas.B: the exclusive participation of private companies in energy projects.
alternativas.C: the elimination of investments in transmission and storage systems.
alternativas.D: technological advances supported by planning and institutional cooperation.
alternativas.E: the reduction of technical personnel involved in renewable energy projects.

questoes.comentario: Inovação tecnológica, planejamento e cooperação interinstitucional.

questoes.enunciado: The conjunction although could be replaced, without changing the essential meaning of the sentence, by
questoes.comentario: Although e even though exprimem concessão.

questoes.enunciado: The expression neither simple nor inexpensive indicates that replacing existing infrastructure is

alternativas.D: relatively simple despite its high cost.

questoes.comentario: Nem simples nem barato: difícil e caro.

questoes.enunciado: Based on the information presented in the text, it can be inferred that the adoption of renewable energy technologies

alternativas.A: requires changes that extend beyond the development of new energy sources.
alternativas.B: will immediately eliminate the need for conventional power systems.
alternativas.C: depends exclusively on decisions made by government authorities.
alternativas.D: makes investments in qualified professionals unnecessary.
alternativas.E: is unlikely to contribute to reducing greenhouse gas emissions.

questoes.comentario: A integração também requer redes de transmissão, armazenamento e pessoal qualificado.

questoes.enunciado: In "If governments and private companies invest in modern transmission networks, renewable energy integration will become more efficient", the conditional structure expresses

alternativas.A: an imaginary situation in the present that is unlikely to occur.
alternativas.B: a past event that cannot be changed.
alternativas.C: a universal scientific truth that always occurs.
alternativas.D: a regret concerning investments that were not made.
alternativas.E: a possible future result dependent on a present condition.

questoes.comentario: First conditional: if + present simple, will + infinitivo sem to.
